register.labelZh: LAND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: land in 可以清楚表示某個行為令人陷入麻煩、債務、困境,甚至要上法庭。；land somebody with something 可以描述某人被迫處理麻煩工作、費用或責任的情況。；land up 適合描述一段旅程或一連串事件最後在並非原先計劃的地方結束。；這些 LAND 表達常見於日常對話、故事、旅遊情境和生活問題之中。
register.summaryEn: Land in can clearly show that an action causes trouble, debt, a difficult situation or even a court case. Land somebody with something helps you describe situations in which a person is left with an unpleasant job, bill or responsibility. Land up is useful when a journey or series of events finishes somewhere that was not originally planned. These LAND expressions often appear in conversations, stories, travel situations and descriptions of everyday problems.
